fact: In 2017 Sao Tome and Principe adopted Law no. 15/2017 on cybercrime which, with the Penal Code, brings domestic criminal law in line with the Budapest Convention's substantive and procedural provisions (Council of Europe note of 22 August 2023).
title: Request by the Democratic Republic of Sao Tome and Principe to be invited to accede (Convention on Cybercrime)
